snippet.title: Octillery VS. Xi Jinping Trailer (Xcorpz Direct October 2021 Showcase)
snippet.description:
The trailer is FOUND MEDIAS!
Jokes aside, this is mostly being put up for archival purposes.

If you want to play Octillery VS. Xi Jinping, it is included in Octillery VS. Collection.
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/875310
https://joeythemarillfan.itch.io/octilleryvscollection
https://gamejolt.com/games/octillerycollection224/792479

But you can also play the legacy version if you so desire to.
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/830333
https://joeythemarillfan.itch.io/octillery-vs-xi-jinping
https://gamejolt.com/games/octillery_xijinping/706392

This game also had another trailer that was animated!
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/830012

And lastly the first few seconds of this older trailer were referenced in the trailer for Octillery VS. Collection!
https://youtu.be/TP3msp5T4d8

Check our work and social media:
Game Jolt: https://gamejolt.com/@severecorp
Bandcamp: https://bandcamp.severecorp.com
Twitter: https://twitter.com/severecorp
